title: Migration / Export Manifest (v1)
description: Validates internal/model.Manifest / model.Action exactly as produced by internal/manifest and internal/profile (import plan, bundle plan, per-adapter export plan) and read back by `gamelib manifest verify`. This is a dry-run/plan contract only: every gamelib subcommand that emits one of these documents is a planner, not an applier — there is no "apply" command, and no field here represents an executed/rolled-back state. Applied and rollback record shapes are intentionally left for a future schema once that functionality exists in the Go tooling.

toolVersion.description: gamelib build/version string that produced this manifest.

operationId.description: Opaque identifier for this planning run, unique enough to correlate a manifest with its reports/logs. Never an account ID or personal identifier.

kind.description: Dynamically constructed plan kind, e.g. "import-plan", "bundle-plan", "<adapter>-export-plan" (steam/decky/playnite/esde/romm). Not a fixed enum in Go — new adapters/planners add new kind strings without a schema change.

sourceDigest.description: Optional (model.Manifest.SourceDigest, json:"sourceDigest,omitempty"). Opaque digest of the planning input (e.g. a profile revision or scan snapshot) used to detect drift between plan and apply time.

actions.description: Always present as a key (model.Manifest.Actions has no omitempty), though may be an empty array when a plan has nothing to do.

warnings.description: Optional (model.Manifest.Warnings, json:"warnings,omitempty"), free-form human-readable planning warnings that did not block the plan.

Action.description: model.Action. "action" and "reason" are always present; every source*/destination* field is independently optional (omitempty) since not all action kinds populate all of them (e.g. a "skip" or "blocked" action may omit destination fields entirely).

action.description: Planned operation kind. Not a fixed enum in Go; observed values in internal/manifest and internal/profile include "copy", "skip", "quarantine", "blocked", and "render".

sourceRoot.description: Root ID the source path is relative to, when the action reads from a scanned root.

destinationRoot.description: Symbolic root token/id the destination path is relative to.

expectedDestination.description: Full expected destination path/URI computed at plan time, used by `gamelib manifest verify` to detect drift before any future apply step.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for this action (e.g. why a file was skipped or quarantined, or which policy rule matched).

metadata.description: Optional free-form key/value metadata (model.Action.Metadata, map[string]string, omitempty).
